list.label: View
list.name: perWorker
list.query: Aggregated : model_name,Per Worker : model_name\, engine\, worker_rank

title: vLLM - UCM Connector (vLLM Metrics)
description: Unified UCM Connector dashboard: common vLLM interface duration at the top, followed by connector-specific Direct and Layerwise diagnostics.

panels.description: P99 wall-clock duration of every runtime UCM Connector interface invoked by vLLM. Use Per Worker to isolate an engine and worker rank.
panels.title: vLLM Connector Interface Duration (P99)

panels.description: Wall-clock per-worker load throughput in GB/s, summed from load_bytes_total over time. Use engine and worker_rank filters to inspect specific DP engines or workers. UNLIKE the (per task) panel above, this view does correctly sum across workers.
panels.title: Connector Load Bandwidth (aggregated)

panels.description: Wall-clock per-worker dump throughput in GB/s, summed from dump_bytes_total over time. Use engine and worker_rank filters to inspect specific DP engines or workers. UNLIKE the (per task) panel above, this view does correctly sum across workers.
panels.title: Connector Dump Bandwidth (aggregated)

panels.description: P50, P90, P95, P99 and Average dump duration in milliseconds for each wait_for_save.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:save_duration_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:save_duration_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Connector Dump Duration

panels.description: P50, P90, P95, P99 and Average blocking wait duration in milliseconds while confirming async UCM connector dump completion.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:save_completion_wait_duration_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:save_completion_wait_duration_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Connector Dump Completion Wait Duration

panels.description: Per-second rate of layerwise batches split by whether the batch had load work, save work, or both. Use this before comparing averages across batch categories.
panels.title: Layerwise / Batch Mix Rate

panels.description: Total batch duration for batches with load work and no save work. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg by engine and worker_rank.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_total_load_only_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_total_load_only_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Layerwise / Batch Duration - Load Only

panels.description: Total batch duration for batches with save work and no load work. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg by engine and worker_rank.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_total_save_only_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_total_save_only_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Layerwise / Batch Duration - Save Only

panels.description: Total batch duration for batches that include both load and save work. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg by engine and worker_rank.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_total_load_save_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_total_load_save_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Layerwise / Batch Duration - Load + Save

panels.description: Stacked average batch duration for load-only batches. Load wait is the batch-level sum of wait_for_layer_load() blocking; other is the remaining batch time.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_load_wait_total_load_only_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_load_wait_total_load_only_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

clamp_min((sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_total_load_only_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_total_load_only_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))) - (sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_load_wait_total_load_only_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_load_wait_total_load_only_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))), 0)

panels.title: Layerwise / Load Only Batch Avg Breakdown

panels.description: Stacked average batch duration for batches with both load and save work. All stack components are batch-level averages over the same batch category.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_load_wait_total_load_save_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_load_wait_total_load_save_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

clamp_min((sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_total_load_save_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_total_load_save_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))) - (sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_load_wait_total_load_save_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_load_wait_total_load_save_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))), 0)

panels.title: Layerwise / Load + Save Batch Avg Breakdown

panels.description: Time get_finished(), preemption flush, or the layerwise polling path actually blocks while waiting for async dump completion. Uses the same metric as the connector dump completion wait panel.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:save_completion_wait_duration_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:save_completion_wait_duration_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Distribution heatmap for batch-level total wait_for_layer_load() blocking time in load-only batches. Cell color/value is request rate from rate(bucket), not raw bucket count.

panels.description: Distribution heatmap for batch-level total wait_for_layer_load() blocking time in load-and-save batches. Cell color/value is request rate from rate(bucket), not raw bucket count.

targets.expr: sort_desc(label_replace(sum by (__name__) (increase({__name__=~"ucm:.*(errors|failure_events)_total", model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__range])), "failure_type", "$1", "__name__", "ucm:(.*)"))

sort_desc(label_replace(sum by (__name__) (increase({__name__=~"ucm:.*(errors|failure_events)_total", model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__range])), "failure_type", "$1", "__name__", "ucm:(.*)"))
